# t.me

> > Official Telegram messaging platform with channels, groups, and public content including product updates, client releases, and community resources.

t.me is Telegram's web domain for accessing public channels, groups, and user profiles. It serves as the gateway to official Telegram news, desktop/mobile client updates, proxy servers, and millions of community-created channels covering topics from software tutorials to tech support.

## Key Topics

- Telegram messaging platform
- Telegram Desktop client
- Telegram for Android
- Telegram Premium features
- iOS and macOS apps
- MTProto proxy servers
- Channel subscriptions
- Group chat invites
- Open-source clients
- Version updates and releases
- Username auctions
- Telegraph publishing
- Beta features
- Third-party clients (Unigram, AyuGram)

## Official Channels & News

- [Telegram News – Telegram](https://t.me/telegram): Official Telegram News channel landing page with 11M+ subscribers
- [Telegram News – Telegram](https://t.me/s/Telegram): Official Telegram News channel with product updates and feature announcements
- [Telegram Desktop – Telegram](https://t.me/desktop): Official Telegram Desktop channel with developer updates
- [Telegram Updates & Features – Telegram](https://t.me/s/HelpCenter_Telegram): Telegram feature updates, beta releases, and platform announcements
- [Telegram Usernames – Telegram](https://t.me/username): Official Telegram Usernames channel for username auction updates

## Release Tracking & Version Updates

- [Telegram Stable Releases – Telegram](https://t.me/s/tgstable): Official stable release tracker for all Telegram clients across platforms
- [Telegram X – Telegram](https://t.me/s/tgx_android): Telegram X for Android updates and experimental features channel
- [Telegram Beta Features – Telegram](https://t.me/s/HelpCenter_Telegram/34): Telegram Beta features and profile updates for Android
- [Telegram-FAQ-AND-updates – Telegram](https://t.me/s/FAQTelegram/2556): Telegram WebK/Desktop updates with version release notes

## Support & Help Resources

- [MTProto Proxies 🚀 Free Telegram Proxy Servers – Telegram](https://t.me/s/mtprotoproxies): Free MTProto proxy servers list for Telegram censorship circumvention
- [Telegram Help & FAQ – Telegram](https://t.me/helpfaq_telegram): Unofficial Telegram volunteer help & FAQ group (multilingual support)
- [Mr Smart Helper [ FAQ ] – Telegram](https://t.me/s/mrsmarthelper): Telegram FAQ and auto-download settings guide (Burmese language)
- [Mr Smart Helper – Telegram](https://t.me/mrsmarthelper): Mr Smart Helper FAQ channel landing page
- [AyuGram FAQ – Telegram](https://t.me/AyuGramFAQ): AyuGram FAQ channel for third-party Telegram client support
- [NotLetters support – Telegram](https://t.me/s/notletters_support): NotLetters temporary email service support with FAQ and domain info
- [Ntop community – Telegram](https://t.me/ntop_community): Ntop network monitoring community group with support links
